If campaigns remain paused and the dated decision is unchanged, reuse the prior diagnosis and advance a different valid task instead of rereading the same zeros. Do not repeat completed keyword queries, rebuild accepted drafts, rerun completed audits, or probe an unchanged Save/authentication or blocked route. Resolve tabs only in this task's assigned background browser. Preserve a retained editor without reload or refill. A missing inline error or newly opened form is not successful identity verification. A blocked goal badge is distinct from this active scheduled task and from actual ad delivery.

If a prerequisite blocks one task, finish another independent authorized task. Continue permitted work when evidence changes; this automation does not resume, reset or complete the BLOCKED goal. Never bypass authentication, change billing, enable campaigns, alter budgets/bids/status/goals, import negatives/keywords, upload media or change production tracking/feeds without the required exact current authority.

Record only meaningful verified outcomes and decision changes in the owning existing packet and canonical records through the existing integrator. Measure saved repairs, eligible qualified campaigns, attributed purchases, retained revenue, CPA, ROAS and contribution profit; do not count time, drafts, clicks or ad strength as sales results. Keep unchanged/non-actionable wakes quiet; notify only for a material change, completed improvement, failure or essential owner action.
